address: 8 rue d'Athenry - ZA Villeneuve-Braouic, Quimperlé, 29300, France
bio: This cricket has taken up abode in Brittany, in a quirky antique shop-style décor, flanked by a lush green patio. The menu is depicted by seasonal market produce, fish of the day and garden veggies. Flavoursome, no-frills recipes (roast hake, spring vegetables and gravy)....
